title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1010 | 百年新野猫、金字塔鳄鱼、太空皮卡丘
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🐱 玻利维亚发现百年一遇的新野猫，长得像家猫、却有豹纹！
🐊 狮身人面像的岩石里，藏着 4500 万年前的鳄鱼化石！
⚡ 一只皮卡丘玩偶在国际空间站漂了 67 天！

📖 Word of the day: fossil（化石）

🎮 Lina 的无厘头二选一：抱抱小野猫，还是骑在鳄鱼化石背上？你选哪个？快问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🐱 Scientists in Bolivia found a new wild cat species — the first in 100 years!
🐊 A 45-million-year-old crocodile fossil was hiding inside the Sphinx's rock!
⚡ A Pikachu toy floated on the Space Station for 67 days!

📖 Word of the day: fossil

🎮 Would you rather cuddle the tiny tiger cat or ride the fossil crocodile?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. fossil（化石）
what's left of an animal or plant from long ago, turned into rock
例：a dinosaur fossil（恐龙化石）

2. species（物种）
a group of animals or plants that are all the same kind
例：a new species of wild cat（一种新的野猫）

3. snout（吻部；动物的鼻子）
the nose and mouth part of an animal
例：a crocodile's long snout（鳄鱼的长吻）

4. float（漂浮）
to stay in the air or on water without falling down
例：Pikachu floated in space（皮卡丘在太空里漂浮）
